purpose: Read self-owned pending Reality, Objective and Reconciliation work from accepted current truth.

routine.return_type: TABLE(reason_code text, subject_kind text, subject_ref uuid, title text, effective_at timestamp with time zone, reconciliation_ref uuid, outcome_ref uuid, purpose_code text, session_ref uuid, session_timing_material_state_ref uuid)

state_history.current_binding: Uses accepted-current policy, Session/placement, Actual, Objective Evaluation and Reconciliation state.
state_history.chronology: Past accepted Activity intervals without any ended Session may enter grouped Reality review when explicit review_on_end or auto_confirm_outcome policy is current; unanswered Objectives enter review independently. Bounded Session and Event placement review remain, with actor effective IANA zone. Missing Actual remains unknown, and no read creates completion.
state_history.immutability_policy: Read-only derived projection; no queue persistence or generic resolve flag.

obligations: reconciliation_open routes only to B10 Reconciliation.
Past never-started Activity Reality review requires an explicit review/auto policy and no accepted Actual; it offers an explicit manual Session or Actual decision.
Pending Objectives on a past accepted Activity interval can be reviewed without an invented Session.
Recorded actual, Session basis or Objective result removes only its corresponding derived work.
